meta.title: Codex-style default workspace
meta.description: Codex-style project-free sessions for DeepSeek Harness. On its first run, each new session in the default workspace creates a date-grouped folder (default-workspace/YYYY-MM-DD/session-id) and switches via native working-directory events, keeping file tools, cd, relative links, sidebar trees, and model/subagent context aligned while keeping sessions listed under the default workspace. The work/ and outputs/ layout is enabled by default (toggleable in Settings). Non-default preferences are stored in ~/.dsh/storages/codex-default-workspace.json and can be removed in one click from Settings or via /codex-default-workspace-clear.
